title: Intervals
summary: An **interval** describes a range with a start and an end, so overlap rules matter.

blocks.prompt: What should an interval trace check first?
choices: The state that proves the next move
The final button the user clicks
The color of the code editor
blocks.why: Check the current end and the next start first. That comparison decides merge or gap.

blocks.prompt: Which debugging habit fits intervals best?
choices: Trace one small state change before trying a larger input
Start with the largest hidden case
Change the data structure after each failed test
Ignore the saved state and read only the final answer
blocks.why: A pair of intervals is enough to test the boundary rule. Larger lists only repeat that comparison.
